summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Obelisco Radical electrical services website with order management integration. All core functionalities tested and working correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Minor overlay interception when trying to add multiple services quickly to cart
ui_bugs.workaround: First service addition opens cart automatically, user can add more services from within cart

passed_tests: Website loads correctly with all sections (Hero, Serviços, Vantagens, FAQ, Contacto)
Navigation menu and mobile menu work properly
Service 'Pedir este serviço' buttons add services to cart correctly
Cart opens automatically when service is added
Cart displays correct service information and pricing
Checkout form accepts all required customer data (Name, Email, Phone, Address, Postal Code, Notes)
Date and time selection work correctly
Payment method selection works (MB Way, Transferência, Dinheiro, Cartão)
Order submission to external API https://tech-app-obelisco.emergent.host/api/orders/public works correctly
Success screen displays after successful order submission
Order appears in tech-app-obelisco order management system
External order management system login works with provided credentials
Order data is correctly formatted and stored in external system
